entries.def:
ζημόω, -ῶ
(ζημία), [in LXX chiefly for עָנַשׁ ;] 
to damage. Pass., to suffer loss, forfeit, lose: absol., 1Co.3.15 before ἐν, 2Co.7.9 with accusative of thing(s) (see B1., § 34, 6), τ. ψυχήν, Mat.16.26, Mrk.8.36; ἑαυτόν, Luk.9.25 τ. πάντα, Php.3.8.†
(AS)

Ζηνᾶς, -ᾶ, accusative -ᾶν
(contr. from Ζηνόδωρος), 
Zenas: Tit.3.13.†
(AS)

ζητέω, -ῶ, 
[in LXX chiefly for בּקשׁ pi., also for דּרשׁ, etc. ;] 
__1. to seek, seek for: Mat.7.7, 8 Luk.11.9, 10; with accusative of person(s), Mrk.1.37, Luk.2.48, Jhn.6.24, al.; id. before ἐν, Act.9.11 with accusative of thing(s), Mat.13.45, Luk.19.10; before ἐν, Luk.13.6, 7; ψυχήν, of plotting against one's life ( Exo.4.19, al.), Mat.2.20, Rom.11.3" (LXX) . Metaphorical, to seek by thinking, search after,…

ζήτημα, -τος, τό
(ζητέω), [in LXX: ζ. τίθεσθαι (דָּרַשׁ ni.), Ezk.36.37 A * ;] 
an inquiry, question: Act.15.2; 18.15; 23.29; 25.19; 26.3.†
(AS)

ζήτησις, -εως, ἡ
(ζητέω). 
__1. a seeking, search. 
__2. a questioning, inquiry, debate: Act.15.2, 7, 2Ti.2.23, Tit.3.9; before περί, Jhn.3.26, Act.25.20, 1Ti.6.4.†
(AS)

ζιζάνιον, -ου, τό
(in Talmud זוּנִין), 
zizanium (EV, tares), a kind of darnel, resembling wheat: Mat.13.25-40 (cf. DB, see word "Tares").†
(AS)

Ζοροβάβελ (FlJ, Ζοροβάβηλος, -ου), ὁ indecl. (Heb. זְרֻבָּבֶל), 
Zerubbabel (1Ch.3.19, al.): Mat.1.12-13 Luk.3.27.†
(AS)

Ζοροβάβελ (FlJ, Ζοροβάβηλος, -ου), ὁ indecl. (Heb. זְרֻבָּבֶל), 
Zerubbabel (1Ch.3.19, al.): Mat.1.12-13 Luk.3.27.†
(AS)

ζόφος, -ου, ὁ
(akin to γνόφος, which see), [in Sm.: Exo.10.22, Job.28.3, Psa.11.2; 91.6, Isa.59.9 * ;] 
in Hom, the gloom of the under-world; hence, darkness, deep gloom (poët. and late prose writers): Heb.12.18, 2Pe.2.4; 2.17, Jude.6,13.†
ὁμίχλη, -ης, ἡ, 
[in LXX for עֲרָפֶל, etc. ;] 
a mist: 2Pe.2.17 
SYN.: νέφος, νεφέλη, both thicker than ὁ (AS)

ζυγός (in cl. more frequently τὸ ζυγόν), -οῦ, ὁ 
(ζεύγνυμι), [in LXX for עֹל, מֹאזֵן, etc. ;] 
__1. a yoke; metaphorically, of bondage or submission to authority: Mat.11.29-30, Act.15.10, Gal.5.1, 1Ti.6.1. 
__2. a balance: Rev.6.5 (of. Isa.40.12, al.).†
(AS)

ζύμη, -ης, ἡ 
[in LXX for חָמֵץ, Exo.12.16; 13.3; 23.18; 34.25, Deu.16.3; שְׂאֹר, Exo.12.16, 19; 13.7, Lev.2.11, Deu.16.4 * ;] 
leaven: Mat.13.33, Luk.13.21; τ. ἄρτου, Mat.16.12. Metaphorical, of a moral influence or tendency, always, exc. in the Parable of the Leaven (Mat.13.33, Luk.13.21), for evil: 1Co.5.6-8, Gal.5.9; ζ. τ. Φαρισαίων, Mat.16.6, 11, Mrk.8.16, Luk.12.1 (Cremer, 723).†
(AS)
